title: Nutritional and bioactive compound profiling of 13 ornamental and edible flowers supports their potential as functional ingredients in sustainable food systems
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00803D, Paper

This study characterized the nutritional composition and bioactive compound profile of thirteen ornamental and edible flower species to support discussion on their potential as functional ingredients within sustainable food systems.
